messages.author: 9bf5070a8dccf419
messages.subject: epistasis LOD in scantwo
parts:
Hi Karl,

Is there a way to determine a significance value using permutations for
the epistasis LOD when running a scantwo? I used quantile() to
generate a value , but I am not certain if this value is only for the
joint LOD or if this also applies to the epistasis LOD.

Thanks, Abby

messages.author: ab8dbe3bec292afe
messages.subject: Re: epistasis LOD in scantwo
parts:
The output from a permutation test with scantwo is a matrix with two
columns.
To get the quantiles of the columns, you need to do something like
the following:

apply(myoutput, 2, quantile, 0.95)

I should say that we're not too happy with this sort of permutation
test, and
are actively working to produce a procedure that is more sensible.

karl
